title: Verify: Public signup flow works end-to-end
description: Test that a new user can sign up, receive magic link, login, and see the display name prompt. REQUIRES BROWSER AUTOMATION - blocked for Kiro/Ralph, only Claude can verify.

acceptanceCriteria.text: New email can request magic link
Display name prompt appears for new user
User appears on leaderboard after setting name

blockedBy: Email verification in dev mode - magic link cannot be accessed without external email service or Resend API configured
notes: Public signup flow (login page UI) is complete per US-048/US-049. Blocker is same as V-009 - email verification step requires Resend API key or direct email access. All UI and route components are implemented and functional.
